'''Eric Shannon''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2002 Modesto Blast From the Past]] on 2 February 2002 with Vader Hate and Revo Mains, according to Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3332">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-05-blast-from-the-past-modesto-2-2d3332/ blast-from-the-past-modesto-2-2], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 5 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-05-blast-from-the-past-modesto-2-2d3332/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
